title: 2026 UK CBAM weight and estimation-record QA controls

sources.title: Keeping records for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
Work out the date you'll need to register for CBAM

facts.source_fact: Imported CBAM goods records must show net mass excluding packaging in kilograms.
The relevant weight is the weight at time of import into the UK.
Net mass may be entered to up to six decimal places.
For net mass over 1 kg, fractions from 0.001 to 0.499 may round down and 0.5 to 0.999 may round up to the nearest kg.
Mass below 1 kg is entered as zero plus decimals up to six places with trailing zeros discarded.
Evidence may include import declarations, invoices, carrier records, bills of lading or packing lists.
CBAM registration will require estimates of expected import weight for the next 12 months.
facts.expected_handling: Separate forecast from actual return weight.

facts.source_fact: Weight estimates are required by sector for aluminium, cement, fertiliser, iron and steel, and hydrogen.
Evidence of how the weight estimate was produced should be retained.
CBAM returns require actual imported weight for the return period, not merely registration estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Do not substitute forecast for actual return data.
